summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')])` to run a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (Bun-cjs bundle with a rotated numeric string array, dispatcher function `WV8StW`, and hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x...`), is not referenced by the package's `main`, is not documented, and bears no relation to the advertised Contentful proxy purpose. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an undocumented obfuscated blob at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: any developer or CI host that runs `npm install` on this version executes the opaque payload under Bun outside the visibility of Node-focused tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
